title: Durable task lifecycle and the governed production path
note: These mutations attack the chain that turns a request into a VERIFIED result: the state machine's edges, the lease that makes ownership adjudicable, separation of duties between executor and verifier, and the verification that re-derives digests from disk rather than trusting what was just recorded. G3 is the sharpest: replay must RE-AUTHORIZE every transition, or a forged log entry becomes state simply by being present.

mutations.name: Q1_terminal_states_escapable
mutations.rationale: a rejected or cancelled task is revived instead of a new one being created

mutations.name: Q2_missing_edge_ignored
mutations.rationale: any task state reaches any other; the lifecycle becomes advisory

mutations.name: Q3_role_not_checked
mutations.rationale: a worker performs a verifier's transition

mutations.name: Q4_lease_not_required
mutations.rationale: a worker reports completion for work it never owned

mutations.name: Q5_lease_holder_not_checked
mutations.rationale: any actor reports on another worker's lease

mutations.name: Q6_lapsed_lease_accepted
mutations.rationale: a worker back from the dead reports success on work someone else redid

mutations.name: Q7_lease_identity_not_checked
mutations.rationale: a stale lease id is accepted as the current one

mutations.name: Q8_self_verification_allowed
mutations.rationale: the executor verifies its own work, so verification verifies nothing

mutations.name: Q9_unknown_executor_assumed_distinct
mutations.rationale: independence is assumed rather than established

mutations.name: Q10_completion_without_a_result
mutations.find:
if req.dst is TaskState.COMPLETED and not is_digest(
            req.result_digest or ""):
mutations.rationale: a completion with nothing to point at is recorded as a result

mutations.name: Q11_lease_survives_requeue
mutations.find:
elif req.dst in (TaskState.QUEUED,) or req.dst in TERMINAL:
        new_lease = None
mutations.rationale: requeued work keeps the dead worker's lease, so nobody else can take it

mutations.name: G1_worker_may_verify_itself
mutations.rationale: the front door stops enforcing separation of duties

mutations.name: G2_projection_accepts_unknown_actions
mutations.find:
except actions.UnknownAction as exc:
                    # Re-raised as ValueError, this projection's existing
mutations.rationale: the task projection silently skips an action it does not understand, so a task's recovered state omits whatever that event recorded and the projection looks healthy while disagreeing with the log

mutations.name: G3_replay_does_not_reauthorize
mutations.rationale: a forged log entry becomes state simply by being present

mutations.name: G4_inputs_not_validated_before_scheduling
mutations.rationale: work is scheduled and executed on inputs the contract rejects

mutations.name: G5_non_completed_outcome_treated_as_success
mutations.rationale: a timed-out or failed run proceeds to evidence capture and verification

mutations.name: G6_artifacts_not_reverified
mutations.rationale: verification passes on bytes that are no longer the cited bytes

mutations.name: G7_missing_artifact_accepted
mutations.rationale: a cited artifact that is gone still verifies

mutations.name: G8_empty_artifact_set_verifies
mutations.rationale: a run that produced nothing is verified

mutations.name: G9_evidence_resolution_not_checked
mutations.rationale: an artifact that is not resolvable as evidence still verifies

mutations.name: G10_capability_scope_widened
mutations.rationale: the grant covers more than the workspace the tool declared

mutations.name: G11_registry_bypassed
mutations.replace:
spec = (self.registry.get(tool_id) if tool_id in self.registry
                else stage10_registry().get('stage10.emit_artifact'))          # default deny
mutations.rationale: an unregistered tool id silently runs a registered tool instead

mutations.name: G12_replay_trusts_the_records_own_src
mutations.rationale: THE HOSTILE-CAMPAIGN FINDING: re-authorizing against a starting state the WRITER supplied authorizes nothing, because every pair in the table becomes available to a forger who names a convenient src -- one appended record moved a task out of VERIFIED, a sealed state

mutations.name: G13_replay_reauthorizes_from_the_claim
mutations.rationale: the disagreement is reported but the check still runs against the forger's src, so the refusal above becomes the only thing standing between a forged record and state
